brief: A bright, daylit clinical exam room. The doctor's desk zone sits on the left under a large window, with a monitor, a mesh task chair and a plant on the desk. A blue guest chair stands in the foreground. The exam table sits against a pale-blue feature wall in the centre, framed by ceiling-track privacy curtains, with a step stool and a wall-mounted otoscope set. A white cabinet run with a sink, a dispenser, a sharps bin and supplies lines the right wall. A steel supply trolley stands by the window. Flat, even, cool-white light comes from recessed ceiling panels and the window. The mood is clean, calm and reassuring.
concept: A hygienic, daylit clinical room where white casework, a pale-blue accent wall and curtains, wipeable grey flooring and even cool light read as calm and sterile.
relations: Pale-blue feature wall + matching blue curtains + blue vinyl upholstery tie the exam zone together and soften the clinical white.
White laminate casework + chrome fittings + seamless pale grey floor = wipeable, hygienic surfaces with no warm or decorative materials.
Large window daylight + recessed flush ceiling panels at neutral-cool 4500K = even, shadowless light for examination.
The desk zone sits by the window and the exam table by the accent wall, separated by the ceiling-track privacy curtain, so the room splits into consult and exam areas.
Sparse furniture with open floor and only two small plants keeps the room uncluttered and easy to clean.
